summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC Ishaq Material culture/108)

data.turoyo: Maḥtiwa u+zād bgawe du+šalawo, <...> háwxaste baq+qərnawoṯayḏe mdawsíwanne, <...> dlo+rəmši,
data.translation: They would put the grain inside this carpet bag, <...> this way they would also stamp them into its corners, <...> so they don’t move,

rationale: Fills Infectum-wa with packing into bag corners; preserves the uncertain plural patient suffix.

data.turoyo: W koḥəškile ʕal ḥḏoḏe, yaʕni mdawsile ġalabe ʕal ḥḏoḏe.
data.translation: und drückt ihn fest zusammen, d. h. stampft ihn fest zusammen.

rationale: Adds the unprefixed Infectum with an object suffix and an explicit compression paraphrase.

data.turoyo: <...> Annaqqa i naqqa d kmaḥtina u ʕafro stene, kəmdawsina, kmətwori aš šəqoṯo, d lə fayəš, rakəx u darbo. <...>
data.translation: <...> Then, whenever we put in the earth, we also tamped it down; the legs were getting battered, so that it would not remain loose and the road settle. <...>

rationale: Thin II Infectum physical-compression cell after round 1; explicit earth patient and road-building purpose. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation; analysis rests on the Turoyo.

summary: All five occurrences were checked. Sense 1 covers compression of grain/chaff and roof material; bag corners are a new location within the same packing action.
JL 11.11/13 and 94/90 already supply the existing examples. PrS 13/17 is also the existing Preterit witness under prs 29/18; only its sense pointer changes.

Plural -nne contrasts with singular earth/material expressions in JL 11.11/13 and the grain-bag narrative. Preserve the mismatch; the verse does not independently identify the suffix referent as bundles.

The reader invokes explicit nyk in verse 19 to confirm the sexual use, but that verse is not supplied for this job and was not opened. The proposal rests on the furnished verse and its euphemistic edition translation, and its lexicalization remains a question.
kəmdawsina is active II Infectum with first-person plural agent. Its habitual road-building context does not itself add -wa morphology.
The road-building use is physical compaction; it provides no further evidence for the separate round-1 sexual sense 2 and no new idiom.
Confirm layo segmentation and whether the sexual use is lexicalized or a contextual packing metaphor. The present new sense is supported by one already quoted witness.
What exactly does plural -nne index in the roof and bag examples: material portions, branches, contents, or a textual error? Do not infer singular agreement from German sie.
Check the prs 29/18 to PrS 13/17 concordance when collating sources; do not treat the two labels as independent attestations.
Jan 2.4/889: confirm the local referents of aš šəqoṯo and rakəx u darbo before revising the machine English. The selected clause is copied unchanged.
Road earth is tamped to prevent looseness/settling, extending the material-compression contexts of round 1 without changing the inherited packing/trampling sense.
